title: Staff shift schedule

memories.content: Runs a restaurant in Hyderabad, open 11 am to 11 pm
8 staff; each works 6 days a week, max 9 hours a day

topics.ask: Make a weekly shift schedule for 8 staff, open 11 am to 11 pm, each works 6 days, max 9 hours.
topics.answer: Two shifts: morning 10:30 am–7:30 pm and evening 2:00 pm–11:00 pm, overlapping in the lunch-to-dinner gap. Four staff on each shift, each with one day off spread across the week so at least 3 people are on every shift every day. Weekend days have nobody off. I'll lay it out as a table once you give me the staff names and anyone's fixed day off.

topics.ask: Names: Ali, Bhanu, Charan, Divya, Esha, Firoz, Ganesh, Hema. Ali and Divya want Monday off.
topics.answer: Morning shift: Ali (off Monday), Bhanu (off Tuesday), Charan (off Wednesday), Ganesh (off Thursday). Evening shift: Divya (off Monday), Esha (off Thursday), Firoz (off Tuesday), Hema (off Wednesday). Each shift keeps 3 people on its quietest weekdays and all 4 on Friday to Sunday.

topics.ask: Esha is on leave next week.
topics.answer: Next week the evening shift has 3 people. Hema moves her day off from Wednesday to Monday only if Divya agrees to swap; otherwise Ganesh covers Esha's Friday to Sunday evenings with a 6-hour shift so nobody passes 9 hours. Confirm with both before publishing.

ask: Show me this week's schedule state and the changes for Esha's leave.
